trans-unit.source: Write to us — we reply by email.

Mantikai is a tarot app for iOS and Android. You ask a question, draw cards from the classic Rider–Waite deck, and AI writes an interpretation of the spread for your question — in English, Russian or Spanish.
trans-unit.target: Mantikai es una app de tarot para iOS y Android. Haces una pregunta, sacas cartas de la clásica baraja Rider-Waite y la IA escribe una interpretación de la tirada para tu pregunta, en español, inglés o ruso.

trans-unit.source: How many readings can I do per day?
Every day you get 1 Card of the Day and 3 readings with a question (Three Cards and The Cross share these 3). The limits reset at midnight UTC; the Home screen shows how many are left.
trans-unit.target: Cada día tienes 1 Carta del día y 3 tiradas con pregunta (Tres cartas y La cruz comparten esas 3). Los límites se renuevan a medianoche UTC; en Inicio puedes ver cuántas te quedan.
trans-unit.note: Answer about daily limits; Three Cards and The Cross are spread names in the app

trans-unit.source: How do I change the language or the card back?
trans-unit.target: ¿Cómo cambio el idioma o el reverso de las cartas?

trans-unit.source: Open Settings → Appearance. There you can choose the language (System, English, Russian or Spanish) and one of five card back designs.
trans-unit.target: Abre Ajustes → Apariencia. Allí puedes elegir el idioma (del sistema, español, inglés o ruso) y uno de los cinco diseños del reverso.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → Appearance» must match the app menu

trans-unit.source: Why do I need to sign in?
Your readings and history are stored in your account, so they are not lost when you change or reinstall your phone, and daily limits are counted per account. You can sign in with Google or Apple.
trans-unit.target: Tus lecturas y tu historial se guardan en tu cuenta, así que no se pierden si cambias o reinstalas el teléfono, y los límites diarios se cuentan por cuenta. Puedes iniciar sesión con Google o Apple.

trans-unit.source: Where can I find my past readings?
In the History tab. Every reading is saved there automatically.
trans-unit.target: En la pestaña Historial. Cada lectura se guarda allí automáticamente.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «History» is the tab name in the app

trans-unit.source: How do I remove a reading from history?
In History, swipe the reading away and confirm. Removing a reading doesn't give back a reading for today.
trans-unit.target: En Historial, desliza la lectura y confirma. Esto no devuelve una lectura para hoy.
trans-unit.note: Answer about removing a reading from history

trans-unit.source: How do I delete my account?
Open Settings → Account → Delete account. Your account and all your readings are deleted immediately and permanently.
trans-unit.target: Abre Ajustes → Cuenta → Eliminar cuenta. Tu cuenta y todas tus lecturas se eliminan de inmediato y para siempre.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → Account → Delete account» must match the app menu

trans-unit.target: Más sobre la eliminación de la cuenta
trans-unit.note: Link to the account deletion page

trans-unit.source: How do I contact support from the app?

trans-unit.source: Open Settings → About → Contact support. The email already contains the app version and your user ID, which helps us answer faster.
trans-unit.target: Abre Ajustes → Acerca de → Escribir a soporte. El correo ya incluye la versión de la aplicación y tu ID de usuario, lo que nos ayuda a responder más rápido.
